verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent capabilities: a documented Changes resource with push notifications that report file and shared-drive changes through the API, plus a sample use case for filling a spreadsheet with file-sharing info for audit. None of this documents a true team audit or event log, such as who viewed, downloaded or shared what, or any SIEM export. missing for 10: a dedicated Drive audit/activity log for admins, actor-attributed access events, a documented audit-log API (e.g., admin reports), SIEM or log-export integration, and independent corroboration.
